_comment: Editorial RRO assignments for the Play tab (nothing ranks on UwUNet). rows: discovery row slug (lowercase; /algorithmiclists/{slug}, /rooms/hot?tag=, /rooms/carousel/{slug}) -> RRO room ids, or "*" = every browsable RRO. The Play > Explore rows (new .. explore_algoendpoint) are DEDUPE sources (gameconfig PlayMenuDedupeSources=Hot,CarouselEndpoint): keep them DISJOINT or a later row empties and hides. hotlist/foryou are deliberate deviations (the reference ranks player rooms there); foryou is a short pick list because Play > Highlights dedupes Most Popular (Hot, every RRO) against it. playlists: curated list id (/curatedlists/bulk, PlaylistById) -> {Name, ItemIds}; not deduped, may overlap. Ids not in rro-rooms.json are dropped. Read per request: edits need no restart.
